description: Sri Lanka Institute of Architects - Amended by Ex. Gaz. No. 1873/07 of July  30, 2014 and Ex. Gaz. No. 2036/42 of 15.09.2017 and the Substitution of the said Regulations of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with the repeal and substitution of regulations governing the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects. It outlines new legal/regulatory frameworks for architectural practice, membership categories, professional definitions, and registration requirements. The content focuses on establishing a regulatory structure and legal definitions rather than government personnel changes, organisational structure, or other specialized categories like land or commerce.
